steps.name: Set closed
steps.do: **Set restaurant as closed** for date range covering today, plus a guest message.

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. **Include closed restaurants** off.

steps.name: Closure override
steps.do: **Create restaurant closure override** so today (or a sub-range) reopens.

steps.name: Opening schedule conflict
steps.do: **Set restaurant opening schedule** overlapping an existing schedule.

steps.name: Resolve overlap
steps.do: Choose **Trim Old Schedules** or **Delete Old Schedules**.

steps.name: Map matches schedule
steps.do: Map on a day implied open by new schedule.

steps.name: Cleanup closed
steps.do: Ensure today is not left closed unintentionally.

steps.name: Verify map open
steps.do: On **Map** with **Specific Map** set to today, with include-closed off.
steps.expect: Normal open marker if intended open.

steps.name: Status messages
steps.do: Confirm each submit showed success status text.

steps.name: Notes
steps.do: Record overlap choice and restaurant name.
